text:
Maria Chen: Heads up — noticed a 6-9% drop in prefix cache hit-rate across prod after the runtime kernel-selection + quant-profile roll (hotfix-312).
Alex P: saw that on the dashboards too. which metric and timeframe?
Maria Chen: token_prefix_hit_rate across the 2am->6am window, aggregate for model:rwd-open-7b, spike coincides with deploy at 02:07.
perf-bot: Deploy hotfix-312 completed at 2026-03-12T02:07:12Z (sha: a1b2c3d). Canary passed latency SLA, failed perf-regression check: prefix_hit_rate -7.1%.
Ryan K: putting profiler output in case it's useful:
```
2026-03-12 02:10:30 profile dump:
- kernel_variant: tiled_attn_v2
- quant_profile: q4_2hf
- avg_seq_len: 48
- batching_policy: dynamic:seq_based
- observed_prefix_hits: 0.62 -> baseline 0.69
- kv_prefetch_misses: +18% (compared to baseline)
```
Jonah: quick question — did we change tokenizer normalization in the model build? small whitespace normalization can split keys.
Lina: I checked, tokenizer SHA unchanged in model upload. The model artifact changed (v1.3 -> v1.4) because we applied fused-attn micro-optimizations.
Alex P: suspect either the tiled_attn_v2 kernel reorders attention state buffers or the quant profile changed rounding that affects KV hash bytes. both can change the cache key.
Maria Chen: logs from prefix-key generation show more collisions but also more unique keys (entropy increased). attaching sample:
```
key_gen_samples:
- baseline: key_hex_prefix=3f7a1b5c...
- current:  key_hex_prefix=3f7a1b5d... (diff at last byte)
- note: diff mostly in bytes 120-128 (end of context hash)
```
Ryan K: that smells like a nondeterminism introduced by kernel reorder or float->int quant rounding differences. we should check deterministic flags.
Jonah: action checklist proposal:
1) reproduce locally with nightly runtime build and v1.4 model on a small fleet.
2) run key-gen in deterministic mode and compare digest bytes.
3) run canary that pins kernel_variant back to tiled_attn_v1 for a subset of traffic.
4) gather token-level diffs for first 50 tokens to see where divergence appears.
Maria Chen: done 1 and 2 already — when enabling `--kv-deterministic` the keys line up with baseline. implies some non-deterministic path in tiled_attn_v2.
Alex P: can we flip quant_profile to previous q4_0hf for a canary instead of kernel? Might be lower risk.
Lina: q4_0hf has lower perf but should preserve key bytes. we can A/B: 10% traffic q4_0hf + tiled_attn_v2, 10% traffic tiled_attn_v1 + q4_2hf.
perf-bot: Experiment created: exp-5632 (10% A: q4_0hf+tiled_attn_v2, 10% B: q4_2hf+tiled_attn_v1). Monitoring: prefix_hit_rate, latency_p95, cost_per_token.
Ryan K: also add a metric for 'first-token-match' (whether first generated token uses cached KV) — we saw warmup misses primarily on initial prompt batches.
Jonah: timeline? we should avoid full rollback unless SLA hit. suggestion: run the two-way canary for 3 hours with high-sensitivity alerts.
Maria Chen: agree. initial local repro suggests tiled_attn_v2 has a different memory write order around KV serializing. I'll open a minimal repro and share a patch to force canonical serialization ordering.
Alex P: if patch is quick, we can hotfix into tiled_attn_v2. fallback plan is to pin kernel_variant to tiled_attn_v1 for 24h.
Lina: flagged to infra to create canary routes and update deployment policy (will assign).
perf-bot: Alert threshold set: prefix_hit_rate drop >3% for 15m will page oncall.
Jonah: FYI — customers using dedicated capacity might not see the same regression if they have pinned model/runtime combinations. good to double-check Dedicated telemetry.
Maria Chen: thanks — I'll post the repro + sample traces once I have them (ETA 90m). for immediate context: try to avoid mass restarts until canary data. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Alex P: noted. thanks team.
Lina: adding ticket RWD-PLT-7892 to track root cause + rollout plan.
Maria Chen: quick follow up after 2h run: canary A (q4_0hf+tiled_attn_v2) restored hit-rate to ~baseline; canary B (q4_2hf+tiled_attn_v1) improved a bit but still -2%. points at quant_profile changing key bytes more than kernel variant. will share diff.
Ryan K: interesting — suggests combined effects. prioritize stable key serialization and add an automated key-compatibility test in CI.
Jonah: adding CI test to run `keygen` against model artifacts and runtime build matrix nightly.
Maria Chen: thanks all — reopening if anything spikes.
Maria Chen: (reaction) :thumbsup:
